title: Lenane la Dipotso tsa Boitekanelo jwa Molwetse - 9
instructions: Mo dibekeng tse pedi tse di fetileng, o ne o tshwenngwa gantsi jang ke mathata a a latelang?

questions.text: Go tlhoka kgatlhego kgotsa boipelo mo go direng dilo
Go ikutlwa o hutsafetse, o gateletswe, kgotsa o se na tsholofelo
Bothata jwa go robala, go tswelela o robetse, kgotsa go robala thata
Go ikutlwa o lapile kgotsa o se na maatla
Go tlhoka keletso ya dijo kgotsa go ja thata
Go ikutlwa o sa itumele ka wena kgotsa e kete o swabisitse wena kgotsa lelapa la gago
Bothata jwa go tlhoma mogopolo mo dilong tse di jaaka go bala kgotsa go lebelela thelebishene
Go tsamaya kgotsa go bua ka bonya thata mo batho ba ka lemogang, kgotsa go se kgone go ikhutsa go feta ka tlwaelo
Dikakanyo tsa gore go ka bo go le botoka fa o sule kgotsa wa intsha kotsi
